Dragapult

Dragon Ghost

Galar · Generation 8

Dragapult is a Dragon/Ghost-type Stealth Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 3 m tall and weighs 50 kg. It evolves from Drakloak. Its highest base stat is Speed (142), with a base stat total of 600.
